fact_rationales.F15: Enlarged cardiac silhouette with increased pulmonary vasculature is highly suggestive of truncus arteriosus due to the excessive pulmonary blood flow, making it less likely for tricuspid atresia which typically presents with decreased pulmonary blood flow.
